name: Epidemiology and Biostatistics PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 enrollment cycle confirmed on page; December 1 funding priority lacks explicit year, so preserved as annual. Admission model not confirmed.

publishedDeadlines.label: Funding priority
publishedDeadlines.note: Annual priority for research/teaching assistantships; deadline year not explicitly repeated.

applicationFee.note: Current central fee $75 first / $25 additional; department pages still show old $100 international. Limited waivers only qualifying-program participants with uploaded evidence; overseas eligibility must be confirmed.

english.note: IELTS every band at least 6. TOEFL new-scale policy applies on/after January 22, 2026; no January 21 rule inferred. Agency reports, MyBest/Home Edition and IELTS Online/One Skill Retake accepted. UGA English Level 6 alternative; DET not accepted. Usually exempt after a degree from an accredited US institution or institution in a primary-English country. At least one current year of US accredited study with strong performance (for example GPA 3.0) may also support waiver. Departments may still require testing; TA English rules are separate.

documents: Unofficial transcripts for review; official after offer
requirements.note: Applicants may come from varied disciplines with strong quantitative skills and MPH-level epidemiology/biostatistics knowledge. For the PhD, applicants without prior relevant master’s training (MPH/MS) or another terminal degree (MD/JD) will not be reviewed as competitive; the program advises its MS route first. Additional biostatistics for Data Analysis/Biostatistics; Biostatistics: calculus(differential, integral, multivariate), linear algebra encouraged. Statement explains research/faculty fit, preparation, funding needs. Optional GRE encouraged.

funding.note: Program admits only with identified funding source; may be investigator RA, TA, fellowship or student-secured support. This is not an unconditional institutional funding guarantee; state independent funding clearly. No amount or coverage guarantee published.
